requirement: v3.3.14: the queue drawer must show human input and machine-generated records as separate blocks, with the machine block folded by default and its count visible even when its records are empty

assertions.human_block: a 人类输入 · N 条 section header is rendered before the human cards (N = session-keyed entries with content)
assertions.machine_block: a 机器生成 · N 条（默认折叠…） details element is rendered whenever any non-session entry exists; N counts all of them, hidden empty ones are named in the summary
assertions.fold_default: the machine block is a <details> without open, so it starts folded on every drawer render
assertions.prior_fixes: v3.3.13 session-name resolution from session/title events and v3.3.12 journal self-heal / Web端 hardening are retained
